edit.description: finalAgentMessage (~L3450): when sawStreamJson is true but neither resultText nor lastAssistantText resolved, fall back to tailBound(raw stdout, MAX_PRIOR_NOCOMMIT) instead of tailBound("", ...).

summary: finalAgentMessage silently returns "" for a §6 voluntary-bail when stdout parses as stream-json but no result/assistant event matches, losing the bail's refused constraint.
tests: a stdout that parses as stream-json (a line with a `type` field) but contains no `result` or `assistant` event yields the bounded raw stdout as the voluntary-bail message instead of an empty string
acceptance: finalAgentMessage falls back to tailBound(stdout, MAX_PRIOR_NOCOMMIT) when stream-json is detected but no text was extracted; the new test fails on the pre-fix tree.
notes: Found sweeping src/Dispatcher.ts (posture-sweep.md). src/Agent.ts documents AgentResult.stdout as an opaque per-provider seam for future non-Claude agents; this closes the silent-empty defect without redesigning that seam — a fuller fix (provider-supplied extraction) is a separate design call, not filed.
